title: Fourier coefficients of the conjunction function
statement: Let $w$ be a nonnegative integer, and define $f:\{-1,1\}^w\to\{-1,1\}$ to equal $-1$ when every coordinate is $-1$ and $1$ otherwise. For $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,w-1\}$, let $\widehat f(S)=\mathbb E_x[f(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i]$, with uniform expectation on the cube. Then $\widehat f(S)=1-2\cdot 2^{-w}$ if $S=\varnothing$, and $\widehat f(S)=-2\cdot 2^{-w}(-1)^{|S|}$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: The width $w$ is a nonnegative integer
The function equals $-1$ only at the all-$-1$ input and equals $1$ elsewhere
$S$ is any subset of the $w$ coordinates
